1.pT: What Is Evil? Whatever Springs from Weakness.

2.pT: It Takes a Great Talent and Skill to Conceal One's Talent and Skill.

3.pT: Man Is an Animal That Makes Bargains: No Other Animal Does This - No Dog Exchanges Bones with Another.

4.pT: We Should Not Be Upset That Others Hide the Truth from Us, When We Hide It So Often from Ourselves.

6.pT: There Are Two Kinds of Lies; One Concerns an Accomplished Fact, the Other Concerns a Future Duty.

7.pT: Muchi na Yûjin Hodo Kiken na Mono wa Nai. Kashikoi Teki no Hô ga Yoppodo Mashi da.

8.pT: Abandon All Hope, Ye Who Enter Here.

9.pT: Man Is Condemned to Be Free.

10.pT: Every Man Has in Himself the Most Dangerous Traitor of All.

11.pT: What People Commonly Call Fate is Mostly Their Own Stupidity.

12.pT: Genius Lives Only One Story Above Madness.

1.pT: Remember to keep a clear head in difficult times.

2.pT: There Are Two Main Human Sins from Which All the Others Derive: Impatience and Indolence

3.pT: Saikô no Tamashii wa, Kono Ue nai Akutoku to Kyokugen no Bitoku o Hakki Dekiru.

4.pT: The Material has to be Created

5.pT: Subete no Shippai wa Seikô e no Katei ni Suginai.

6.pT: Adversity Is the First Path to Truth.

7.pT: To doubt everything or to believe everything are two equally convenient solutions, both dispense with the necessity of reflection.

8.pT: Mune no Soko de, Kizu wa Shizuka ni Ikite Iru.

9.pT: If you make a mistake and do not correct it, this is called a mistake.

10.pT: Hitobito wa Tsune ni Sono Hametsu o Negatte Iru. Itsuwari no Zen ni Azamukareru ga Yue ni.

11.pT: A man who cannot command himself will always be a slave

12.pT: Force without wisdom falls of its own weight

13.pT: The worst enemy you can meet will always be yourself

1.pT: The strongest principle of growth lies in the human choice.

2.pT: Hito ni totte, Hoka no Ningen wa Dômô na Ookami no Yô na Mono da.

3.pT: We never forget what we endeavor to forget.

4.pT: Anata ni Dekiru no wa Jibun no Mokuteki no Tame ni Kôdô Suru Koto made de, Sono Kekka o Nozomu Yô ni Suru Koto wa Dekinai.

6.pT: Aku o Okonau Yori mo, Sono Aku ni Kizutsukerareru Hô ga Yoi.

7.pT: People will do anything, no matter how absurd, in order to avoid facing their own souls

8.pT: Kako o Kaeriminu Mono wa Sore o Kurikaeshi, Sabakareru.

9.pT: Saikô no Hô wa, Saidai no Fusei o Umidasu.

10.pT: The first cause of Absurd conclusions I ascribe to the want of Method.

11.pT: Ai ni wa Tatta Hitotsu no Kimari Shika Nai. Sore wa Ai Suru Mono o Kôfuku ni Michibiku Koto da.

12.pT: Yokubô no Tame ni Sekai o Kaeru no de wa Naku, Mazu Onore o Kaeyo.

13.pT: Ai wa Mottomo Yoi Kyôshi de Aru.
